subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “It also asked users to take a photo after parking.”?
options: Some students complained because it was less convenient.
Travelers said the rules made the space comfortable for everyone.
Some residents complained that the square looked less beautiful.
Some complained that the rules made bike sharing less convenient.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「Some students complained because it was less convenient.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Travelers said the rules made the space comfortable for everyone.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Some residents complained that the square looked less beautiful.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「It also asked users to take a photo after parking. Some complained that the rules made bike sharing less convenient.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「It also asked users to take a photo after parking. Some complained that the rules made bike sharing less convenient.」，答案為「Some complained that the rules made bike sharing less convenient.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Some complained that the rules made bike sharing less convenient.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
